name: Payment voucher for a reverse charge payment
definition: A payment voucher is issued under clause (g) of section 31(3) at the time of making payment to a supplier where the recipient pays the tax. Rule 52 fixes ten particulars, (a) to (j); clause (a) is the only particular in this chapter that qualifies the SUPPLIER's identity with 'if registered'.
why_it_exists: Under reverse charge the person paying the tax is not the person making the supply. The payment voucher is the document the tax-paying recipient creates, which is why the supplier may have no GSTIN to state.
outputs: the set of rule 52 particulars found
the set of mandatory particulars absent
preconditions: tax on the supply is payable by the recipient
a payment is being made to the supplier
exceptions: rule 54(5) extends the rule 54(2) and 54(4) relaxations to payment vouchers
common_mistakes: rejecting a payment voucher because the supplier has no GSTIN — clause (a) says 'if registered'
expecting a reverse-charge flag — rule 52 has no such particular, because the whole document exists for a reverse charge payment
treating the payment voucher as the document that creates the tax liability rather than as the record of the payment
legal_references: UNKNOWN — clause (g) of sub-section (3) of section 31 of the CGST Act was not read for this record
gst_references: UNKNOWN — source is the Rules as at 01-01-2022; later amendments not held locally
confidence_factors: weak when it is unknown whether the supply attracts reverse charge at all
weak when the supplier is unregistered and cannot be identified by GSTIN
validation_checks: all ten particulars (a) to (j) are present, subject to (i) applying only to inter-State supplies
the absence of a supplier GSTIN is not reported as a defect where the supplier is unregistered
examples: a voucher for a payment to an unregistered goods transport operator, showing the operator's name and address without a GSTIN
counterexamples: a voucher with no amount paid — clause (f) fails

evidence.quote: 52. Payment voucher.-A payment voucher referred to in clause (g) of sub-section (3) of section 31 shall contain the following particulars, namely:-
name, address and Goods and Services Tax Identification Number of the supplier if registered;
